containerOverrides.name: arc-backend

allowedInfrastructureMutations: one RunTask using existing exact API task definition/roles/network
StopTask only that exact diagnostic if it exceeds 180 seconds
reason: Existing API ECS Exec returns TargetNotConnectedException; live accepted-session and index audit cannot be claimed complete.
lostResponsePolicy: RunTask clientToken is fixed. Reconcile exact startedBy/task-definition/command hash before any retry; never duplicate a task after an ambiguous response.
expectedOutput: Counts/index metadata and readiness booleans only, exported from the new exact CloudWatch stream. No media or credentials.
rollback: No service change. Diagnostic exits; stopped-task record/log remains. No application state rollback needed.
